title: A Formally Verified Certificate Proof of the Maximum Number of Stable Matchings for Six Men and Six Women
summary: We give a complete Lean 4 verification of the theorem that the maximum number of stable matchings for six men and six women with strict complete preferences is f(6)=48. Jo (2026) previously proved the unrestricted upper bound, and Benjamin, Converse, and Krieger (1995) supplied an attaining construction. Our contribution is an alternative, fully formalized proof using a finite certificate; the value 48 and the unrestricted theorem are already known.
